candidate.rationale: Specifying equality of the visible ThreadId via the uninterpreted spec fn `view()` avoids requiring direct tracked-object equality (which the checker flagged as uncallable/determinism-unknown). This still captures the intended semantic — the cloned IsThread represents the same thread — while being more likely to be checkable against an external/opaque clone implementation.
risks: The verifier may expect a different implicit return name (e.g. `res` or `ret`); minor renaming may be necessary.
Weaker than `result@ == self@`: this asserts equality of the observable ThreadId, not literal ghost/tracked-object identity.
If `view()` is not treated as deterministic for external bodies, determinism may still be unproven.
